Exact shadcn Button Rounded fixture. Source evidence: registry/upstream/snapshots/shadcn/button.tsx and registry/upstream/derived/shadcn-button.json record the new-york-v4 recipe where size.icon is size-9; registry/shadcn/button/ui/config.ts records the current Base Nova recipe where size.icon is size-8; the live new-york-v4 example source from https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york-v4/button-rounded.json supplies variant="outline", size="icon", className="rounded-full", and ArrowUpIcon. Rendered origin evidence on 2026-06-22 for selector main [data-slot=button][data-variant=outline][data-size=icon].rounded-full reported final classes including size-8 rounded-full, width 32, height 32, zero padding, 1px borders, icon-only empty text, and a 16px rendered lucide arrow-up SVG. DOM comparison ignores only type because Foldkit Ui.Button emits type="button" for safe inert buttons while the current origin button omits the attribute.
